description: Add AI provider settings UI, API validation route, and AI-powered contextual message generation. Also adjust camera layout to max 2/3 width on 1400px screens, and show detected persons panel with individual emotions below the camera.
steps: Install openai npm package: `npm install openai`

Create src/lib/ai-config.ts - Define TypeScript types for AI provider config (baseUrl, apiKey, modelName). Include a helper to create an OpenAI client instance from config. This should work with OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM (https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1), Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1), or any OpenAI-compatible provider.

Create src/app/api/ai/validate/route.ts - POST endpoint that receives {baseUrl, apiKey, model} and makes a test chat completion call (a simple 'say hello' prompt) to validate the connection. Return success/failure with error details.

Create src/app/api/ai/generate-message/route.ts - POST endpoint that receives {emotions: EmotionType[], personCount: number, dominantEmotion: string, eventName: string} plus reads AI config from request headers or body. Calls the LLM to generate a contextual message in Spanish about the detected emotions. Falls back to the static random message if AI is not configured or fails.

Create src/components/AISettingsModal.tsx - A modal/dialog component with form fields: Provider Base URL (with placeholders showing OpenAI/NVIDIA/Ollama examples), API Key (password input), Model Name. Include a 'Validar Conexion' button that calls the validate endpoint and shows success/error feedback. Store config in localStorage. Style with Tailwind, dark theme matching existing UI.
Modify src/app/page.tsx - Add a settings gear icon button in the header that opens the AISettingsModal. Pass AI config state to FaceDetector component.

Modify src/components/FaceDetector.tsx - (a) Limit the video container width to max-w-[933px] (2/3 of 1400px) with mx-auto centering. (b) When AI is configured, call the generate-message API endpoint instead of using getRandomMessage() for the contextual message (throttle to avoid too many API calls, e.g., once every capture interval). (c) Below the video/emotion message section, ALWAYS show a 'Detecciones' panel that displays: number of detected persons and a list of each person with their individual emotion emoji and label (not just when >1 person like current code).

Update the individual emotions breakdown in FaceDetector.tsx to always show below the camera (even for 1 person), styled as a clear panel with a heading like 'Personas detectadas: N' and each person's emotion.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run build` succeeds without TypeScript errors
A settings modal can be opened from the main page header
The settings modal allows entering base URL, API key, and model name
The validate button makes a POST to /api/ai/validate and shows the result
When AI is configured, contextual messages are generated via the LLM API
When AI is not configured or fails, the existing static random messages are used as fallback
The camera video container does not exceed 933px width (2/3 of 1400px)
A detection panel always shows below the camera showing person count and individual emotions
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it completes successfully with exit code 0
findings: Build succeeds with no TypeScript errors. The openai package was added successfully. The lucide-react package was already present in the project for icons. All new API routes (/api/ai/validate, /api/ai/generate-message) are server-rendered on demand as expected. Review fixes applied: (1) useRef for currentMessage to fix stale closure in saveCapture, (2) removed currentMessage from useEffect deps to prevent detection loop restart, (3) sanitized eventName and used system/user message separation for prompt injection mitigation, (4) added 10s AbortSignal timeout to AI completion calls, (5) added security note about API key in request body.
